newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj tender document published.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj tender document published.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state has published the tender document for the sale of its state bank Banco do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (Banerj) due to be privatized this month, a planning department spokesman said.

Banerj will be sold off in a closed envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange June 17 at 1400 local time/1700 GMT for a base price of 310 million reais ($289.72 million), the spokesman said. The auction price, of which 50 million reais ($46.73 million) can be paid for in cash or privatization bonds and the rest with other government bonds, will have to be paid June 20.

Interested investors have until June 13 to qualify for the sale and deliver the necessary financial guarantees to the stock exchange clearing house, he said. The clearing house will announce June 16 the list of qualified bidders.
Rio de Janeiro state twice failed last year to sell the bank due to worries on debt. The previous minimum price set at 480 million reais ($448.6 million) was considered too high by investors.

Seven financial institutions -- Banco BBA Creditanstalt, BankBoston Corp's Bank of Boston Brazil unit, General Electric Co's General Electric Capital Corp, Banco CCF do Brasil, Companhia de Investimentos Latino-Americana, Bradesco SA and Banco Itau SA -- prequalified for Banerj's sale last year, but only two of them, retail banks Bradesco and Itau, actually signed up to bid at the auction.
Those investors who already prequalified last year will not have to prequalify again under the new privatization rules, the spokesman said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
